description: One library slide: its labels (purpose, why it works, archetype, insight device, impact), its component layout (v3), its design DNA (the 40 largest region boxes with colour and type roles, text structure) and its mockup image. Use an id from find_references. Build your own slide from it; never copy it. A deck id from find_deck_flows returns that deck's flow instead: its steps in order, each with a slide id and whether that slide is in the library (available).
name: get_reference
title: Get a reference slide or deck flow
